item.title: Saskatoon council approves drop-in centre relocation despite community concerns
item.description: Saskatoon city councillors are backing a new downtown drop-in centre despite pushback from local businesses and community members.

item.title: Poilievre to fly to UK, Germany on first international trip as Opposition leader
item.description: As Prime Minister Mark Carney heads to India, Australia, and Japan, his chief political opponent Pierre Poilievre is bound for the UK and Germany.

item.title: Indian government no longer targeting Canadians, senior official says on eve of PM’s visit
item.description: The comments were the first to suggest India had halted the clandestine operation that Canada has linked to a murder and other crimes.

item.title: Okanagan Falls teen seriously injured in skiing accident at Apex Mountain Resort
item.description: “For maybe 30 seconds, two or three times a day, I get my son back. And those moments are starting to happen more often," said Sean Hall.

item.title: Nationwide prescribed burn program being launched, administered through UBC-Okanagan
item.description: The new program will train more people to safely plan and carry out prescribed burns, create national training standards and provide hands-on experience in the field.

item.title: Lapu Lapu Festival new location revealed as grieving son asks for pause
item.description: A Burnaby man who lost his entire family at last year’s Lapu Lapu Block Party is calling on organizers to halt plans for this year’s event.

item.title: Vassell leads Spurs past Raptors 110-107
item.description: Devin Vassell led all scorers with 21 points as the San Antonio Spurs rallied to a 110-107 win over the Toronto Raptors on Wednesday.

item.title: Saskatoon’s The Purrfect Cup Cat Cafe sees another act of vandalism
item.description: After seeing multiple attacks of vandalism since 2024, The Purrfect Cup Cat Cafe had their first break-in, costing them $1,000 in damage and theft.

item.title: Why travel experts say book your summer travel now
item.description: Barry Choi says it all comes down to dynamic pricing based on supply and demand. Prices for airfare and hotels can change daily, even hourly.

item.title: Perfetti’s first career OT goal lifts Winnipeg Jets past Vancouver 3-2
item.description: Cole Perfetti scored his third goal in his last four games while Kyle Connor and Gabriel Vilardi also scored as the Jets picked up two points against the NHL-worst Canucks.
